title: Pushpa: The Rise
overview: A daily wage laborer rises through the ranks of a powerful red sandalwood smuggling syndicate in the forests of Andhra Pradesh, challenging rivals and corrupt authorities while carving out his own empire.

title: Toxic
overview: A gritty period gangster drama following the rise of a feared underworld figure whose choices blur the line between power, loyalty, and survival in a violent criminal world.

title: The Odyssey
overview: An epic retelling of Homer's classic tale, following Odysseus on his perilous journey home after the Trojan War, facing mythical creatures, divine intervention, and impossible trials.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
overview: With the world having forgotten Peter Parker, Spider-Man faces new threats alone while adapting to a life without his former friends, discovering unexpected challenges that test both the hero and the man behind the mask.

title: Welcome to the Jungle
overview: A chaotic action-comedy where a team of eccentric characters embarks on a dangerous adventure packed with mistaken identities, explosive action, and hilarious misadventures.
